items.name: Chest percussion and postural drainage - individualized plan
items.zh: 拍痰／胸部叩擊與姿位引流
steps: Assess secretion retention, cough effectiveness and the individual need for airway clearance.
Confirm patient-specific suitability, sites, positioning and planned duration before treatment.
Monitor tolerance and respiratory status; stop and escalate if clinical deterioration occurs.
stepsZh: 評估分泌物滯留、咳嗽能力及個別呼吸道清除需求。
執行前確認適合性、叩擊部位、姿勢與預定時間；不可直接套用固定姿位。
觀察呼吸與耐受情形；不適或病況惡化時停止並通報。
items.notes: 適用情況須個別評估；不因單純肺炎診斷而例行開立。先核對出血、胸部損傷、疼痛及姿勢耐受等風險；時間、部位、姿勢與頻率由醫師指定。呼吸困難、發紺、明顯疼痛等不適時停止並通報。

items.name: Oxygen therapy
steps: Use the prescribed device, flow and target saturation.
Monitor response and document escalation criteria.
stepsZh: 使用指定裝置、流量及目標血氧飽和度。
監測反應，記錄需升級處理的條件。

items.name: Diet order
steps: Specify diet type, restrictions and route.
Verify swallowing safety and tolerance when oral intake is intended.
stepsZh: 指定飲食種類、限制及進食途徑。
口服進食前確認吞嚥安全與耐受情形。

items.name: Activity order
steps: Specify permitted activity, assistance and restrictions.
Review tolerance and safety before mobilization.
stepsZh: 指定允許活動、協助方式及限制。
下床前評估耐受情形與安全。

items.name: On service of V.S.
steps: Assign the attending service when the order is approved.
stepsZh: 醫囑核准後，指派收治主治醫師。

items.name: Fever routine - assessment and monitoring for age 16 and over
steps: Measure temperature, pulse, respiratory rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation and level of consciousness.
Assess hydration, urine output and red flags; hydration only if swallowing is safe and no fluid restriction applies.
Escalate for deterioration; antipyretic drug orders require a separate prescription and pharmacist review.
items.notes: 成人套組。檢查感染來源與病況惡化徵象；懷疑感染／敗血症時依個別風險進一步處理，不以發燒或退燒反應單獨判定。孕產病人須另採適當專科評估；不自動開立抗生素、培養或補液。
stepsZh: 記錄體溫、心跳、呼吸、血壓、血氧飽和度與意識狀態。
評估水分、尿量及危險徵象；補充飲水須確認吞嚥安全且無限水要求。
病況惡化應通報；退燒藥須另開處方並由藥師審核。

items.name: Fever assessment and observation in children under 5
steps: Measure and record temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate and clinical appearance.
Assess hydration, urine output and red flags; hydration only if swallowing is safe and no fluid restriction applies.
Escalate for deterioration; antipyretic drug orders require a separate prescription and pharmacist review.
Assess appearance, responsiveness, breathing, circulation and hydration; arrange prompt clinical assessment for warning signs.
items.notes: 未滿3個月且體溫≥38°C屬嚴重疾病高風險；3至6個月且≥39°C至少為中度風險。需依年齡及病況即時評估，不得只等待常規測量。此套組不自動開藥、抽血或輸液。
stepsZh: 測量並記錄體溫、心跳、呼吸及整體臨床表現。
評估水分、尿量及危險徵象；補充飲水須確認吞嚥安全且無限水要求。
病況惡化應通報；退燒藥須另開處方並由藥師審核。
評估膚色、活動與反應、呼吸、循環及水分；有危險徵象須即時醫療評估。

items.name: Stroke swallowing and neurological care
steps: Neurological observation and escalation plan.
Swallow screen by a trained professional before oral food, fluids or medication.
Review hydration/nutrition route and oral care.
stepsZh: 訂定神經學觀察與異常通報計畫。
口服食物、液體或藥物前，由受訓人員完成吞嚥篩檢。
評估水分與營養途徑，並進行口腔照護。

items.name: Perioperative assessment and safety
steps: Review procedure, consent and surgical safety checklist.
Document individualized fasting, fluid and nutrition plan.
Assess VTE risk and postoperative recovery setting.
Assess pain and functional recovery; medication orders remain separate.
stepsZh: 核對手術／處置、同意書及手術安全清單。
記錄個別禁食、輸液與營養計畫。
評估靜脈血栓風險及術後恢復照護環境。
評估疼痛與功能恢復；藥品須另外開立。

items.name: Postpartum assessment
steps: Assess vaginal bleeding, uterine tone/fundal height and vital signs.
Document voiding, pain, wound/perineal recovery and feeding support.
Escalate for heavy bleeding, suspected infection or other deterioration.
stepsZh: 評估陰道出血、子宮張力／宮底高度及生命徵象。
記錄排尿、疼痛、傷口／會陰恢復及哺餵支持。
大量出血、疑似感染或其他惡化情形應通報。

items.name: Newborn danger-sign observation
steps: Assess feeding, activity, breathing, temperature, jaundice and history of convulsion.
Escalate for danger signs; do not substitute a generic adult routine.
stepsZh: 評估進食、活動、呼吸、體溫、黃疸及抽搐病史。
出現危險徵象應通報；不可直接套用成人常規。

items.name: Pediatric gastroenteritis and hydration assessment
items.zh: 兒童腸胃炎與水分評估
steps: Assess dehydration and shock signs, urine output, intake and vomiting/stool history.
Use an individualized rehydration plan with recorded weight; no automatic adult volume.
Reassess response and escalate for shock, deterioration or inability to tolerate planned fluids.
stepsZh: 評估脫水及休克徵象、尿量、攝入量與嘔吐／排便病史。
依已記錄體重訂定個別補液計畫，不自動套用成人容量。
重新評估反應；休克、病況惡化或無法耐受預定補液時應通報。

items.name: Mental-health safety and observation plan
items.zh: 精神科安全與觀察計畫
steps: Assess current distress and immediate physical/mental healthcare needs.
Request age-appropriate mental-health assessment.
Individualize observation level, responsible staff and review time with the patient/team.
Document consent or appropriate framework; observation is not an automatic restraint order.
stepsZh: 評估目前痛苦及身心醫療的立即需求。
安排符合年齡的精神健康評估。
與病人及團隊訂定觀察程度、負責人員及重新評估時間。
記錄同意或適當依據；觀察計畫不等於約束醫囑。

steps: Confirm the indication and document the individualized assessment.
Record patient-specific findings, planned observations and escalation criteria.

記錄病人個別結果、觀察計畫及需通報的條件。
與負責專科團隊檢視計畫；治療或藥物需另外開立。
